subject: Remove duplicate pointer-key hashtable callbacks (#4745)
reason: Pure refactor with no observable behaviour change. In bgiteration.c the removed pointerHash was byte-for-byte Thomas Wang's 64-bit mix, which is exactly what the new shared hashtablePointerHash computes (wangHash64), and the removed pointerCompare equals the hashtable's NULL-callback default (key1 == key2, hashtable.c compareKeys). In cluster_legacy.c the removed dictPtrHash/dictPtrCompare are bit-identical to the hashtable's NULL-callback defaults (siphash over the pointer's bytes, pointer equality), so clusterSlotDictType computes the same hashes as before.
